newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle $67, brisk - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle $67, brisk - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 30,300 head slaughter steers and 18,600 heifers; 87,800 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,700 head formulated and 400 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 65.00-66.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 65.50-66.50. Confirmed - 48,900 Week Ago - 37,700 Year Ago - 4,300
Wk to Date - 87,800 Week Ago - 108,200 Year Ago - 115,700
